<h1 title="Class RefreshRouteOptions" class="title">Class RefreshRouteOptions</h1>
</div>
<div class="inheritance" title="Inheritance Tree"><a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html" title="class or interface in java.lang" class="external-link">java.lang.Object</a>
<div class="inheritance"><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestnativebase" title="class in com.here">com.here.NativeBase</a>

<section class="class-description" id="class-description">
<hr>
<div class="type-signature"><span class="annotations"><a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Deprecated.html" title="class or interface in java.lang" class="external-link">@Deprecated</a>
</span><span class="modifiers">public final class </span><span class="element-name type-name-label">RefreshRouteOptions</span>
<span class="extends-implements">extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestnativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></span></div>
<div class="deprecation-block"><span class="deprecated-label">Deprecated.</span>
<div class="deprecation-comment"><p>Will be removed in v4.28.0. Use the <code>RoutingOptions</code> class instead.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="block"><p>The options to specify how to refresh an already calculated route identified by a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestroutehandle" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>RouteHandle</code></a>. All the
 options that may result in a new route shape are ignored as no new route is calculated. Instead, only the data that
 accompanies a route, such as traffic information, can be refreshed. Therefore, the following route options are ignored:
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestrouteoptions#alternatives"><code>RouteOptions.alternatives</code></a>, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestrouteoptions#arrivalTime"><code>RouteOptions.arrivalTime</code></a>, and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestrouteoptions#optimizationMode"><code>RouteOptions.optimizationMode</code></a>.
 If new <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestavoidanceoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>AvoidanceOptions</code></a> are specified, they are ignored as well and instead new <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestsectionnotice" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>SectionNotice</code></a>'s
 are generated that indicate where the requested <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestavoidanceoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>AvoidanceOptions</code></a> are violated. Note that when
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-latestevcaroptions#ensureReachability"><code>EVCarOptions.ensureReachability</code></a> is set to true, the route refresh request will fail as this option
 is incompatible with a fixed route shape.
 If any of the ignored options are important, consider calculating a new route instead.
 </p><p><strong>Note:</strong> This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</p></div>
</section>
